page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number 380 to its left. Catchword "tutius" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: stum, nec debeat esse poenae locus. l. Sancimus. Cod. de Pœn. Adeoque propter hoc factum, nemo calumniam metuere debeat. l. 2. Cod. Ad l. Corn. de Sicar. Et si quis forte actionem in quempiam poenae nomine intenter, ea exceptione justi homicidii elidi posset. Gothefr. in not. ad d. l. 2. Cod & DD. ibidem citati. Quid quòd ille, qui in ludis licitis virtutis aut exercitii militaris causa institutis aliquem occidit, nec civili, nec criminali judicio conveniri possit. l. 7. §. 4. D. Ad l. Aquil. Cujac. 20. obs. 21. Schrader. de Feud. part. 9. c. 4. n. 37. sub fin. Moller. ad const. Saxon. part. 4. const. 10. n. 6. Befold. delib. jur. tit. P. Ad l. Aquil. n. 2. p. 571.
Non tamen improbandi videntur nostratium mores, secundum quos, an quia ita fieri oportet, an quia id remedium

page.notes: The first word is a fragment of a word from the previous page ("stum" from "factum"); it is kept as a fragment. Long s is written as s throughout. "obf." is read as "obs.". The text in the column is cut off at "remedium"; "tutius" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The printed hyphen in "exercitii" / "militaris" is a line-end break in the print, so the words are written whole. The italic/roman split of the citations is read from the scan and is approximate. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
